title: Ashbury Best Rate Guarantee Terms for Room Reservations
content:
## Terms

1. When a guest finds the same hotel, room type, dates and occupancy offered to the public at a lower rate, the Best Rate Guarantee team may match it for a Room Reservations reservation.
2. A claim is accepted only on plans covered by the Best Rate Guarantee.
3. **Claim window.** The claim must be made no later than the end of the plan's claim window, in calendar days following the day the reservation was booked. The window closes at 23:59 hotel local time on the calendar date obtained by adding the claim-window days, in whole calendar days, to the booked date; a claim made at that minute is accepted. The booked date is read from the reservation record.
4. **Latest claim before arrival.** A claim must also be made no later than 23:59 hotel local time on the calendar date the plan's latest-claim days before the arrival date.
5. **The lower rate.** The lower rate must undercut the reservation's nightly rate by more than 1 percent, be bookable at the time of the claim, and not be a member-only, opaque, package or group rate of another seller.
6. **The match.** When matched, the nightly rate becomes the lower rate less the plan's additional discount, in percent, rounded to the cent, for every night of the reservation, and the adjustment date is recorded.
7. A reservation is adjusted at most once and only while its status is confirmed.
8. Guest services does not validate competitor rates and never changes a rate under this guarantee; the Best Rate Guarantee team's validation is the only basis for an adjustment.

## The windows worked through (hypothetical Flexible Rate reservation: 1-day window, latest claim 1 day before arrival)

| Booked | Arrival | Window closes | Latest claim before arrival | Claim at 23:59 on 4 March | Claim at 00:01 on 5 March |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 March | 20 March | 4 March, 23:59 | 19 March, 23:59 | Within both limits | Outside the window |

## The 1 percent test and the match (hypothetical figures)

| Reservation's nightly rate | Lower public rate | Undercut | More than 1%? | Matched nightly rate (25% additional discount) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 200.00 | 198.00 | exactly 1% | No | — |
| 200.00 | 190.00 | 5% | Yes | 190.00 less 25%: 142.50 |

Exactly 1 percent does not qualify; the undercut must be more than 1 percent.
